LegacyBody.test-surface-design: Mirror EventSink pattern from src-tauri/src/m013b/watch.rs. Define CommandRunner trait with run(&self, bin: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<Output, RunErr>. Production wraps std::process::Command. Test impl is MockRunner recording calls + returning scripted exit codes / stdout / stderr. Pref-domain isolation in module tests via in-memory HashMap<String, plist::Value>. Wave-level integration test gated #[cfg(target_os = "macos")] runs against real defaults under tempfile::TempDir-scoped pref domain.
LegacyBody.wave-follow-up: Wave: integration test on macOS-14 runner using real /usr/bin/defaults + lsregister; arch parity check (E-01); domain scope assertion (E-03).
LegacyBody.phase-follow-up: Alpha gate: user smoke WT-1 — click "Set as default" in Settings, double-click .md in Finder, verify Mark.app dispatches the Apple Event. Cannot be observed from in-process API; mandatory user checkpoint.
